title: Cindy B NDE 6207
content: I was slicing a bagel and cut the tender area between the thumb and forefinger. Held the cut under running water in the kitchen sink, and felt myself getting lightheaded. I felt like I was going to faint, so I laid myself down on the kitchen floor on my back. Everything went black. All of a sudden, I was pulled through a dark tunnel, which started becoming filled with a glowing blue light. I was not in my body. Although I felt like I was moving very quickly, I was able to see shadowy figures lining the sides of the tunnel, and I heard them talking, saying, 'Why is she here now?' 'What's she doing here?' 'She's not supposed to be here.' I heard all of them at the same time, and I became nervous, thinking I wasn't supposed to be there, but I was being pulled and couldn't stop myself. At that moment, I heard the faint sound of my husband calling my name. I don't know how to explain this, but I focused on the sound of his voice and it became louder, and louder. I felt myself leap into the sound of his voice and opened my eyes. He was standing over me, freaked out. He said that my eyes rolled upward, I started convulsing, with very spasmodic motions from my arms and legs. I was also freaked out from the experience. I suffered for days with a painful headache and listlessness, spending most of my time lying down. Both my grandmother and mother have seizure disorders as well. I don't really know if I was near death, but the tunnel experience sounds so much like what NDErs have talked about. I would like to mention that I have always been a bit psychic, and have had out of body experiences (some blissful, some evil), and spirit visitation.

arrival.other_being_detail: Shadowy figures lining the sides of the tunnel, heard talking: 'Why is she here now?' 'What's she doing here?' 'She's not supposed to be here.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Focused on the sound of her husband's voice; it became louder; she 'leap[ed] into the sound' and opened her eyes.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Cut hand while slicing a bagel; felt lightheaded and fainted/blackout; husband observed convulsions.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard shadowy figures talking in the tunnel; focused on husband's voice to return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/blackout followed by being pulled through a dark tunnel with blue light; returned upon hearing and focusing on husband's voice.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard multiple shadowy figures in the tunnel simultaneously saying she was not supposed to be there; return occurred by focusing on husband's voice.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Why is she here now?' 'What's she doing here?' 'She's not supposed to be here.'
